name: Banana Islands
hook: Three islands, no cars, no crowds
description: A short boat ride from the peninsula to Dublin, Ricketts, and Mes-Meheux — reef snorkeling, a slave-trade-era history that's still visible on the shoreline, and an off-grid pace that's part of the draw.
bestTime: November through April (dry season, calmest seas)

quickFacts.flightNote: Road transfer to Kent, then a roughly 20-minute boat crossing
quickFacts.climate: Tropical — hot and humid, calmest seas in dry season

topExperiences: Snorkeling the reef off Dublin island
A walk to the old British gun emplacements
A slow crossing back to the peninsula at sunset
